objective: Improve verified merchant and customer usability gaps in the running local app
acceptance_criteria: Merchants can edit product details without losing existing images, variants, categories or status
Product search matches names and SKUs
All storefront themes support working category filters, search, sorting and useful empty states
Customers can discover order tracking from the storefront and order confirmation
Missing or broken product images show a clear placeholder instead of unrelated photos
Changed flows pass browser regressions and affected backend checks, build succeeds and the local stack runs the changes
